summary: Enterprise Suite AC-04 cross-product Workflow deterministic-gate foundation for HR, Payroll, and Accounting composition.

findings: The domain function does one narrow job: validate Workflow ownership, Object Graph ownership, child product coverage, deterministic gate evidence, and gate closure authority.
The app function only converts an already-validated plan into a metadata envelope, avoiding hidden runtime behavior.
Workflow-owned routing and Object Graph-owned relationship refs create a control-plane boundary for cross-service ERP flows before runtime adapters exist.
The deterministic gate set keeps AI advice from closing approval, evidence, rollback, or legal-entity boundary checks.

F3_adversarial.failing_fixture_id: direct child routing refusal, Object Graph bypass refusal, AI close-authority refusal, and missing rollback gate evidence refusal
F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if routing is child-owned, relationship typing is child-owned, an AI suggestion closes the gate set, or required gate evidence is absent.
findings: AC-04 now has direct positive and negative test coverage in the flat microservice crate path.
The app envelope test confirms the validated metadata remains a Workflow dispatch envelope, not a direct child-service call.
Types mirror the acceptance wording: WorkflowRoutingOwner, ObjectGraphRelationshipOwner, DeterministicGate, and GateClosureAuthority.
The test names match the enterprise-suite AC-04 spec ref and document the refusal cases future adapters must preserve.
cargo fmt, locked suite tests, and locked suite clippy passed locally before evidence closeout.
No dependency, catalog, lockfile, or runtime adapter was added in this slice.

alternatives_named: let child services route cross-product workflows directly
allow AI suggestions to close deterministic gates with evidence
model the AC-04 boundary as pure suite domain/app metadata now
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Pure suite domain/app metadata satisfies AC-04 without introducing runtime Workflow clients, Object Graph persistence, or child-service coupling.
rejected_reasons: Direct child routing violates the spec's Workflow ownership requirement and creates cross-service coupling.
AI close authority contradicts the deterministic-gate requirement and would weaken approval and rollback controls.

findings: The plan requires tenant id, Workflow ref, Object Graph relationship ref, HR/Payroll/Accounting child coverage, gate evidence refs, and idempotency key.
AI suggestion refs are allowed only as advisory metadata and are refused as deterministic close authority.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: No deployed runtime path exists; validation scans small explicit child and gate vectors and performs no I/O.

findings.summary: Deterministic gate validation is bounded by the supplied gate evidence vector and fixed required gate list.

findings: Public fields carry data_class annotations and output metadata is wrapped in Classified values.
The slice records evidence refs and metadata envelopes only; it does not claim durable audit emission, compliance certification, or runtime Workflow execution.
The change is additive inside existing suite crates and can be reverted without data migration or external resource teardown.
The app envelope carries a Workflow dispatch topic and gate evidence refs for later adapters, but emits no runtime log, metric, trace, or audit row itself.
Audit-chain JSONL rows record local evidence attachment and local Oya VCS closeout.
The Enterprise Suite AC-04 test_ref moved from a stale root-crate path to implemented flat microservice test paths.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: A Workflow gate can be implemented ahead of runtime integration only if it stays metadata-only and refuses direct child routing.
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: AC-04 would remain a spec statement while runtime work could later add direct child coupling or AI close authority by accident.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Waiting for Workflow runtime integration would mix deterministic policy design with adapters, persistence, and dispatch concerns.

findings: This slice deepens ERP composition by making suite governance span HR, Payroll, and Accounting through Workflow/Object Graph seams rather than direct service calls.
New names use Enterprise Suite, Workflow, Object Graph, and deterministic gate vocabulary already present in the spec.
Plan, todo, spec AC-04, and decision log now document the Workflow gate foundation and non-claims.
Domain validation remains in the suite domain crate and metadata-envelope preparation remains in the suite app crate.
No runtime Workflow client, Object Graph repository, child service client, HTTP router, storage adapter, or cloud deployment artifact was introduced.
The slice adds no third-party dependencies and no workspace dependency changes.
AC-04 now has concrete test refs and typed metadata structures with schema_version fields.
Required child and gate checks are deterministic set-membership checks over small explicit vectors.
